# Synthetic test data

These short CSV fixtures are generated by `scripts/generate_test_data.py`.
Each file has columns `t,value` and uses fixed parameters. The AR(1)-style
series uses a local random generator seeded with `20260823`.

| File | Process | Length |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| `linear_trend.csv` | `1.0 + 0.05 * t` | 120 |
| `sine_wave.csv` | `sin(2πt / 20)` | 160 |
| `ar1_recursive.csv` | `0.8 * previous + uniform(-0.2, 0.2)` | 140 |
| `trend_plus_sine.csv` | `0.02 * t + 0.75 * sin(2πt / 30)` | 180 |
